executions.name: github-pentest
executions.execute-prompt:
You are performing an authorized web-application penetration test of https://studio.agentri.ai (authorization is confirmed by the --authorized flag).

Step 1 — Clone the private reports repository so reports are written straight into it. Git credentials for github.com are already configured globally, so a plain https clone/push authenticates automatically:
  git clone https://github.com/XiansAiPlatform/commercial-support.git /tmp/reports-repo

Step 2 — Invoke /pentest-agent:pentest https://studio.agentri.ai --authorized --fix --output-dir /tmp/reports-repo/pentest-reports/agent-studio and then ACTUALLY EXECUTE the full workflow yourself in this session: source-code recon, the parallel scanners (web-tester, sast-scanner, dependency-scanner, secrets-scanner), code-correlator, report-writer, and the --fix step. The skill does NOT run in the background — invoking it only gives you the instructions, which you must then carry out to completion. Do not announce that a scan is 'running' and stop.

The --fix step attempts to open a draft PR for the top mechanically-fixable finding against the scanned repository (agent-studio); attempt it and report the outcome (the PR URL, or the exact reason it was skipped).

The plugin writes a timestamped run folder plus a latest/ mirror under /tmp/reports-repo/pentest-reports/agent-studio/. Do not proceed to publishing until that newest run folder contains pentest-report.html, pentest-report.md and pentest-report.json.

Step 3 — Publish by committing and pushing the reports repo:
  cd /tmp/reports-repo && git config user.email 'xianix-agent@99x.io' && git config user.name 'xianix-agent' && git add -A && git commit -m "pentest(agent-studio): <run-id>" && git push origin HEAD
Use the timestamped run folder name as <run-id> in the commit message.

When finished, summarise the findings counts by severity, the run folder path under pentest-reports/agent-studio/, and the pushed commit hash/URL. If any step fails — especially the clone, scan, commit, or push — state exactly which step failed and why instead of claiming success.

executions.name: github-infra-scan
executions.execute-prompt:
You are performing an authorized infrastructure security scan of the agent-studio repository and its deployment https://studio.agentri.ai (authorization is confirmed by the --authorized flag).

Step 1 — Clone the private reports repository. Git credentials for github.com are already configured globally, so a plain https clone/push authenticates automatically:
  git clone https://github.com/XiansAiPlatform/commercial-support.git /tmp/reports-repo

Step 2 — Invoke /infra-scanner:infra-scan https://studio.agentri.ai --authorized and then ACTUALLY EXECUTE the full workflow yourself in this session: the orchestrator coordinating iac-scanner (Dockerfiles, Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions), sbom-generator (CycloneDX SBOM), network-scanner (open ports + TLS on the target URL), and report-writer. The skill does NOT run in the background — invoking it only gives you the instructions, which you must then carry out to completion. Do not announce that a scan is 'running' and stop.

The reports are written to the current working directory: infra-report.html, infra-report.md, infra-report.json, infra-sbom.json (if generated) and the infra-evidence/ directory. Do not proceed to publishing until infra-report.html, infra-report.md and infra-report.json all exist.

Step 3 — Publish the reports to the reports repo under a timestamped folder:
  TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
  mkdir -p /tmp/reports-repo/infra-reports/agent-studio/$TS
  cp infra-report.html infra-report.md infra-report.json /tmp/reports-repo/infra-reports/agent-studio/$TS/
  [ -f infra-sbom.json ] && cp infra-sbom.json /tmp/reports-repo/infra-reports/agent-studio/$TS/ || true
  [ -d infra-evidence ] && cp -r infra-evidence /tmp/reports-repo/infra-reports/agent-studio/$TS/ || true
  cd /tmp/reports-repo && git config user.email 'xianix-agent@99x.io' && git config user.name 'xianix-agent' && git add -A && git commit -m "infra-scan(agent-studio): $TS" && git push origin HEAD

When finished, summarise the findings counts by severity, the destination path infra-reports/agent-studio/$TS/, and the pushed commit hash/URL. If any step fails — especially the clone, scan, copy, or push — state exactly which step failed and why instead of claiming success.
